notes.title: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent English Version Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/14b7458a8e9e786ffb09d43affc277dcb4e9ff3e.png[/img]

[b]Gear up Adventurer!

Your adventure starts here, TODAY![/b]

[b]English support is finally here![/b] The team at Acquire are happy to share with you the English release of Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent. We would like to take this opportunity to thank you all once again for the ongoing support you have shown for this game as we welcome our English-speaking adventurers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/7f68b5b3cc6491557d777dff7f51493c619b716e.png[/img]

The [b]Continent of Pedra[/b], home to the four nations, is slowly transforming into a labyrinth dungeon with monsters roaming the lands! Join [b]Alex, Citrin and Lazuli[/b] as they fight and wander the entire island in search of the truth. Win? Lose? That all comes down to how [b]YOU[/b] lead the charge! [b]Summon and pick up[/b] your students and claim [b]victory[/b] with your own hands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/01f043def8aa17e7a29d3a4656585ff5c8cc346b.gif[/img]

Before you begin your journey why not try out our [b]English Demo, also available now![/b] We wish you well on your travels across the Continent of Pedra and we hope you enjoy Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/3430335ead0e4fc6fe3e99c0279abd4b72f7f5fe.png[/img]

notes.title: Adventure Academia News Article – English support will be available on Dec. 9th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/7b81dab8157e208f5f2214de7e7d3e8ab78443dc.png[/img]

We are excited to bring some more exciting news to everyone for Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent! Once again, we would like to [b]thank you all[/b] for your continued support as we count down to the English release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/ee46ffab311d513f71ee43cbc5ef5e378d3e2ecd.png[/img]
[b]Hello Adventurers! [/b]

Mark your calendars… English support for Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent will officially be releasing on [b]9th December![/b] You can look forward to a variety of new content in the coming weeks showcasing more of the game, but in the meantime if you are eager to start your adventure, we also have an [b]English demo[/b] for you to try out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/b2876dcd199140f6a691fd73b3a8f7c7f3806cdb.gif[/img]

notes.title: Adventure Academia News Article – English Release (Steam Feature)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/b83ea4cc9ef38809e8498ba16289d36074c14585.png[/img]
[b]Greetings Fellow Adventurers!
[/b]Thank you for your continued support on Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent. We would like to bring you some[b] updated news on the English release[/b] today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/526faeda0e34a63c3a09e84e02b7a6de519f1f8c.png[/img]

We are pleased to announce support for an [b]English version[/b] of Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent, [b]COMING SOON![/b] Look out for further announcements in the coming weeks with more details and release dates.
Get ready for a super sneak peek ahead of release, as we are also very excited to announce the upcoming release of the English version of the demo! More news will be coming soon, so keep your eyes peeled for more updates on the[b] demo release[/b] and [b]pre-orders! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/205f3fc5713ca27d578ffa84bffc8e9b66e5f591.png[/img]

notes.title: Sep.13th. Keyboard controls issue has been fixed
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent.

We would like to report on some changes we have made to the game.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
・Fixed the keyboard control issue with some keys.　 
・Fixed the key assign for keyboard control
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Please refer to the new key assign from here.
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1904730/manuals/ttm_keyoperation_en.pdf

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42487426/755ea4a358667319575f9e1de252237d22f62e59.png[/img]
You can also confirm it from the "View the quick reference" tab located on the bottom right on the store page.

We hope this fixes the problem for you and we would like to apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Regarding the keyboard controls
notes.content:
We are receiving multiple reports that you can not properly control the game or have difficulty with some keyboards while playing the game.

We are currently investigating the case.
Once we have confirmed the cause, we will report it as soon as we can.

Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Released today! Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent Launch 10% off sale
notes.content:
[i]Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent[/i] is now fully launched.
*English language is not available yet but will be added to the same product later on with an update.

We are holding a 10% off launch sale for one week from September 8th JST.

We’ve also released a Season Pass that includes upcoming DLC at a discount, and a soundtrack featuring the full version of the theme song.
For more details, please check the Steam store page!

notes.title: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent Demo is out!
notes.content:
You can enjoy the gameplay until the boss battle of the first map, the Firelands!
You can use the same save data for the full version, too!
The English version is not available yet, but we hope you feel the atmosphere!

*This demo is only available in Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean.
*The English version is currently under preparation.
